*Kosei Torihiki* no. 858, published on April 15, carries my case note on the EU's Slovak Telekom judgment of the Court of Justice, discussing recent developments in EU refusal-to-deal law and their implications for Japanese law.

Publication was delayed for various reasons, so I wrote it about six months ago, but the analysis takes into account the General Court's judgment in the Google case.
